BiblicalUsage: Jehoiachin is named once, in Ezekiel 1:2. In Ezekiel 1:2 we read, "In the fifth day of the month, which was the fifth year of king Jehoiachin's captivity,".
TheologicalSignificance: Jehoiachin is recorded once and kept forever, and I take comfort in that.
